about: A status refusal acts only when the status is set, once the move has hit (Showdown's gen-9 Comatose, Shields Down and the Veils refuse in onSetStatus, after the accuracy step): a Thunder Wave that misses a Comatose Pokemon is a miss. Before, the refusal spoke over the miss (ov12_0224BC2C let BLOCKED_BY_ABILITY past every DID_NOT_HIT bit). A level-10 Pikachu is given Thunder Wave in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Splash, given Comatose (set:): with the accuracy roll forced to miss, "Comatose blocks Thunder Wave!" is not said (on the base ROM it was); with it forced to hit, it is.
